qualification: x86 firmware virtio transport binding and Linux boot regression

spark.note: Gate run included the firmware link target before it was separated to preserve SDK 2.1 gate support. No runtime source changed afterward.

intel.result: PASS exit 0; x86 Linux ring3 initramfs syscall proof verified

limitations: Adapter initialization and Linux userspace regression are target-qualified; no virtio device is registered by this firmware yet.
Registered-device MMIO dispatch has component coverage, not Intel guest traffic coverage.
Canonical device services, device discovery, notification handling and lifecycle teardown remain incomplete.
Firmware link qualification requires SDK 2.3 VMCS controls; SDK 2.1 is explicitly rejected by the existing firmware compile guard.
